description: This Java source file defines a service class named ReCreateProvisioningEntryRequestCommandHandler, which handles commands related to recreating provisioning entries in the Fineract accounting provisioning module. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and processes commands by delegating to the ProvisioningEntriesWritePlatformService.

classes.name: ReCreateProvisioningEntryRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service implementing command handling for recreating provisioning entries, marked with annotations to specify command type and transactional behavior.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to recreate provisioning entries by delegating to the provisioningEntriesWritePlatformService.
